title: Why is OpenAI losing so many executives?
excerpt: Executives keep leaving OpenAI. What's going on?
content_html:
OpenAI's Chief Revenue Officer announced today that she is leaving the AI giant.

"I wanted to let you know that I made the difficult decision to leave OpenAI in the coming weeks to pursue other opportunities," said Denise Dresser, the now-former OpenAI CRO, in a post shared to her LinkedIn. "I’m incredibly proud of all we’ve accomplished together and deeply grateful to the extraordinary people and customers who made this chapter so meaningful."

On its own, Dresser's departure may not be so noteworthy. However, what is notable is that Dresser is the second OpenAI executive to leave the company just this week, and one of several to leave the company within the last few months.

You May Also Like

Two days ago, OpenAI executive Brad Lightcap also announced his departure from OpenAI. Over his years with the company, Lightcap wore many hats. Lightcap was promoted to OpenAI's COO role in April but later shifted out of that position to lead special projects within the company.

“Over the last few months, I’ve been focused on the next horizon,” Lightcap said in a note to OpenAI employees, as reported by Bloomberg. “I believe there are a few important things the world will need to get right as we enter this next period. I’ll have more to share soon.”

Mashable Light Speed

Just one month ago, OpenAI lost its number two executive, Fidji Simo. Simo had gone on medical leave months earlier and said she ultimately decided to leave in July as a result of ongoing health issues. Perhaps Simo would have stayed with the company if not for these circumstances. 

However, Simo wasn't the only high-profile OpenAI employee to leave in July either. That very same month, OpenAI head ethicist Chloé Bakalar departed the company as well. While Bakalar's departure apparently occurred last month, it was only recently revealed in a Financial Times report.

The tenures of the departing executives vary widely: Lightcap had been at the company since 2018, while Dresser leaving after just nine months.

Are these OpenAI departures a sign of something more concerning going on within the company? OpenAI has dealt with multiple high-profile departures at once before. For example, chief marketing officer Kate Rouch left in April of this year, shortly before OpenAI lost two research heads Kevin Weil and Bill Peebles.

With that said, these recent departures are certainly something to keep tabs on. Concerns surrounding OpenAI's safety protocols are at all-time highs following a few high-profile security incidents. Is this really the best time for OpenAI to lose Bakalar, who was reportedly its only dedicated ethicist?

OpenAI CEO Sam Altman has recently been going on about how the company is on the cusp of bringing a kind of digital superintelligence once confined to science fiction novels to reality. Would these executives not want to be with OpenAI for this achievement?

As of now, the departing former OpenAI executives haven't shared exactly what spurred their decisions to leave the company or why they chose this particular moment. Perhaps we'll find out more soon enough.

content_html_zh:
OpenAI 首席营收官今天宣布她将离开这家人工智能巨头。

前 OpenAI CRO 丹尼斯·德莱瑟 (Denise Dresser) 在 LinkedIn 上分享的一篇帖子中表示：“我想让大家知道，我做出了一个艰难的决定，在未来几周内离开 OpenAI，去寻找其他机会。” “我对我们共同取得的成就感到无比自豪，并对那些让这一章变得如此有意义的杰出人士和客户深表感谢。”

就其本身而言，德莱瑟的离开可能并不那么值得注意。 然而，值得注意的是，德莱瑟是本周第二位离开公司的 OpenAI 高管，也是过去几个月内离开公司的几位高管之一。

你可能也喜欢

两天前，OpenAI 高管 Brad Lightcap 也宣布离开 OpenAI。 在公司工作的这些年里，Lightcap 担任过许多职务。 Lightcap 在 4 月份被提升为 OpenAI 的首席运营官，但后来转而领导公司内部的特殊项目。

据彭博社报道，Lightcap 在给 OpenAI 员工的一份说明中表示：“在过去的几个月里，我一直专注于下一步。” “我相信，当我们进入下一个时期时，世界需要解决一些重要的事情。 我很快就会有更多内容要分享。”

可混搭光速

就在一个月前，OpenAI 失去了第二号高管 Fidji Simo。 西莫几个月前就休了病假，并表示由于持续的健康问题，她最终决定在 7 月离开。 如果不是因为这些情况，西莫也许会留在公司。

然而，Simo 也不是 7 月份唯一一位离职的 OpenAI 知名员工。 同月，OpenAI 首席伦理学家 Chloé Bakalar 也离开了公司。 虽然巴卡拉尔的离职显然发生在上个月，但直到最近《金融时报》的报道才披露这一消息。

离职高管的任期差异很大：Lightcap 自 2018 年以来一直在公司工作，而 Dresser 仅在 9 个月后就离开了。

OpenAI 的这些离职是否表明公司内部正在发生更多令人担忧的事情？ OpenAI 此前曾处理过多次备受瞩目的离职事件。 例如，首席营销官 Kate Rouch 于今年 4 月离职，不久前 OpenAI 失去了两位研究主管 Kevin Weil 和 Bill Peebles。

话虽如此，最近的这些离职肯定值得密切关注。 在发生几起备受瞩目的安全事件后，对 OpenAI 安全协议的担忧达到了历史最高水平。 这真的是 OpenAI 失去 Bakalar 的最佳时机吗？据报道，Bakalar 是其唯一的专门伦理学家？

OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 最近表示，该公司即将将一种曾经仅限于科幻小说的数字超级智能带入现实。 难道这些高管不想与 OpenAI 一起取得这一成就吗？

截至目前，即将离职的 OpenAI 前高管尚未透露究竟是什么原因促使他们决定离开公司，也没有透露他们为何选择这个特定时刻。 也许我们很快就会知道更多。
